[NSTG.6.3] **No storage callback transfers ownership.** Every tree and
string a storage callback receives — the cache key and value, a cache
removal, a `Json` call argument — is dispatcher-allocated and
dispatcher-freed; the callback borrows it for the call. `cached()` reads the
engine's own cache ([NSTG.2.2.1]), so no callback returns a value libds
takes.
